mapper.sql: part_id AS "id",part_nm AS "name",hq_yn AS "hqYn",use_yn AS "useYn", reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_bs_part WHERE hq_yn='N' AND position(#{q} in part_nm)>0 AND use_yn=#{useYn} ORDER BY part_id
SELECT FROM tb_bs_part WHERE part_id=#{id} AND hq_yn='N' FOR UPDATE

SELECT part_id AS "partId",aply_bgn_ym AS "month",aply_end_ym AS "endMonth",part_ldr_user_id AS "leaderUserId", prft_dstrb_rt AS "profitRate",sales_exps_amt AS "salesExpenseAmount",reg_user_id AS "regUserId", reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_bs_part_std WHERE part_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_nm FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{id}
SELECT user_id FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user u JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id=#{id} AND u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND r.role_id='SALES_LDR' AND r.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_bs_part WHERE part_nm=#{name})

SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT dev_id) FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE part_id=#{id}) AS "personCount", (SELECT count(DISTINCT pp.proj_id) FROM tb_pj_proj_part pp JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=pp.proj_id WHERE pp.part_id=#{id} AND p.proj_stat_cd IN ('ING','PRE') AND (pp.aply_bgn_ym=(SELECT max(prev.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_pj_proj_part prev WHERE prev.proj_id=pp.proj_id AND prev.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month}) OR pp.aply_bgn_ym > #{month})) AS "projectCount"
SELECT lpad(std_val::bigint::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT max(close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bs_part SET part_nm=#{name},use_yn=#{useYn}, mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE part_id=#{id} AND hq_yn='N'
